farfetchlever-farfetch:lever:6d0a45ec-cd.title: Head of Business Development
farfetchlever-farfetch:lever:6d0a45ec-cd.description: FARFETCH exists for the love of fashion. Our mission is to be the global platform for luxury fashion, connecting creators, curators and consumers. We're a positive platform for good, bringing together an incredible creative community made up by our people, our partners and our customers. This community is at the heart of our business success. We welcome differences, empower individuality and celebrate diverse skills and perspectives, creating an inclusive environment for everyone. We are FARFETCH for All. COMMERCIAL We're partnering with global brands and the most influential and renowned boutique curators to bring our customers an unrivalled range of fashion to empower their individuality. We’re relationship builders, we’re solution finders and we’re analysts. We work with all areas of the FARFETCH business to improve our social and environmental impact while delivering business success. We want to empower our consumers to buy better, improve our operational footprint, and explore new business models that improve our impact. LONDON Our office is located in Old Street, London's tech hub. Our open-plan space is ideal for collaborative working. When you're not doing what's never been done, you can enjoy a team lunch on our large outdoor terrace, or join a yoga class in our dedicated studio. THE ROLE The Head of Business Development is responsible for leading business development across Brands and Boutiques for the EMEA region, with dotted line accountability from Americas and APAC regions. The Head of BD will own the pipeline of brand and boutique signings and be responsible for setting targets and driving the team to deliver against new business opportunities. Concurrently, the Head of BD will also oversee expansions and terminations within the existing partner portfolio. The role will require thought leadership on new commercial & operational models that best fit partner needs and reflect changes in the competitive landscape; a strong and detailed grasp on the specifics of FARFETCH’s legal and financial setup; and close collaboration with Integrations (PI) on partner technical needs, and Merchandising on pipeline prioritisation. Finally, the Head of BD should also oversee the transition from new partner signing into ongoing partner management once handed over to Brand Management, Account Management, and Partner Success/Service teams.

jobgether-jobgether:lever:07a024f6-819b-.title: Systems Support
jobgether-jobgether:lever:07a024f6-819b-.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Systems Support based in Canada. This role is responsible for supporting business-critical systems and ensuring technical issues are addressed quickly and accurately. You’ll manage incoming support tickets, troubleshoot issues, and coordinate with the appropriate teams to drive fixes through resolution. The position combines hands-on system support with operational monitoring and may involve deploying fixes or rerunning failed jobs. You’ll work with tools such as Autotime, Control-M, SQL, and Service Central in a structured support environment. After an initial training period, the role will include participation in an on-call rotation to provide coverage for critical issues outside standard working hours. This is a strong opportunity for a technically capable support professional who enjoys troubleshooting and keeping essential systems running reliably. Receive, review, and service technical support tickets submitted through Service Central and Autotime. Troubleshoot system and operational issues, identify the appropriate resolution path, and ensure tickets progress efficiently. Route tickets requiring development or application changes to the appropriate technical teams for resolution. Monitor and support business-critical processes and help minimize disruptions to system operations. Perform authorized operational fixes, including rerunning failed jobs when required. Support Autotime activities such as configuration and timecard-related issue resolution. Use SQL queries, when needed, to retrieve information and assist with troubleshooting and ticket resolution. Work with Control-M to monitor and support automated job management processes. Maintain clear communication and documentation throughout the ticket lifecycle. Participate in an on-call rotation to provide support for critical incidents outside regular business hours, including occasional weekends. Complete initial system training and progressively take ownership of support activities as technical proficiency develops. Requirements Proven hands-on experience supporting Autotime is required. Experience with Control-M and automated job management is required. Familiarity with Service Central or similar enterprise ticketing and service management platforms. Working knowledge of SQL , particularly the ability to query information for troubleshooting and ticket investigation, is preferred. Experience with Autotime configuration, timecard troubleshooting, or related operational support activities. Strong troubleshooting and analytical skills, with the ability to investigate issues methodically and determine appropriate next steps. Ability to distinguish between issues that can be resolved operationally and those requiring escalation to development or other technical teams. Strong organizational skills and attention to detail when managing multiple tickets and priorities. Clear written and verbal communication skills for coordinating with technical teams and business stakeholders. Ability to learn system-specific processes quickly and work independently after completing initial training. Flexibility to participate in an on-call rotation and provide occasional after-hours or weekend support for business-critical tickets. Benefits Opportunity to work with enterprise systems including Autotime, Control-M, SQL, and Service Central. Structured initial training to build familiarity with the supported environment and processes. Hands-on experience supporting business-critical applications and automated operational workflows. Participation in an organized on-call rotation designed to distribute after-hours support responsibilities across the team. Opportunity to develop deeper expertise in enterprise systems support, incident management, and technical troubleshooting. Collaborative environment with opportunities to work alongside development and technical

jobgether-jobgether:lever:586b6476-c9ca-.title: Sr Data Scientist Lead
jobgether-jobgether:lever:586b6476-c9ca-.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Sr Data Scientist Lead based in Brazil. This is a high-impact technical leadership role for an experienced Data Scientist ready to combine hands-on expertise with strategic influence. You will lead the design, development, and delivery of data science and machine learning solutions that address complex business challenges. The role covers the full data science lifecycle, from problem definition and experimentation through modeling, deployment, monitoring, and optimization. You will work extensively with cloud-based data and machine learning environments, with a particular focus on AWS. Beyond individual technical contributions, you will guide technical decisions, mentor data professionals, and establish effective analytical and engineering practices. Working with international stakeholders, product teams, data engineers, and software engineers, you will help turn data into measurable business value. Lead the design and implementation of data science initiatives , defining methodologies, technical approaches, analytical frameworks, and best practices across projects. Develop, evaluate, and optimize statistical and machine learning models to solve complex business problems and generate actionable insights. Own the complete data science lifecycle, including data exploration, feature engineering, model development, validation, deployment, monitoring, and continuous improvement. Design and implement scalable AWS-based data science and machine learning solutions , applying appropriate cloud architecture and engineering practices. Provide technical leadership to Data Scientists and other technical professionals, guiding modeling decisions, architecture discussions, technical reviews, and engineering practices. Partner with business stakeholders, product teams, data engineers, and software engineers to translate business challenges into effective data-driven solutions. Monitor model performance and reliability in production, identifying opportunities to improve accuracy, scalability, efficiency, and business impact. Contribute to long-term data science strategy , analytical standards, methodologies, and practices that support organizational growth. Mentor team members, encourage knowledge sharing, and help establish a culture of technical excellence and continuous learning. Drive projects from initial concept through production delivery while balancing technical quality, business priorities, and practical implementation considerations. Requirements: 6+ years of professional experience in Data Science, Machine Learning, Advanced Analytics, or a related field, including experience leading technical initiatives or teams. Strong hands-on expertise in statistical modeling, machine learning, predictive analytics, experimentation, and data-driven problem solving . Advanced proficiency in Python , with experience using data science and machine learning libraries such as Pandas, NumPy, and Scikit-learn or equivalent tools. Strong understanding of supervised and unsupervised learning, feature engineering, model evaluation, optimization, and production machine learning practices. Solid hands-on experience designing or implementing data science and machine learning solutions on AWS . Strong SQL skills and experience working with large datasets, data warehouses, and complex data environments. Demonstrated technical leadership skills, including the ability to lead technical discussions, make modeling and architecture decisions, mentor colleagues, and drive initiatives from concept to production. Strong analytical, critical-thinking, and problem-solving abilities, with a pragmatic approach to complex business and technical challenges. Excellent communication skills and advanced English proficiency , with the ability to explain complex technical concepts clearly to international teams, business stakeholders, and leadership

jobgether-jobgether:lever:92429f7c-6b3a-.title: Power System Engineer III
jobgether-jobgether:lever:92429f7c-6b3a-.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Power System Engineer III based in the United States. The Power System Engineer III will contribute to the design and modernization of complex electrical grids, with a strong focus on renewable energy integration. The role centers on generation and load interconnection studies across the Western Electricity Coordinating Council footprint. You will evaluate grid capacity, system impacts, and interconnection strategies for projects involving solar PV, battery energy storage, and wind generation. The position combines detailed power system modeling, engineering analysis, project execution, and client collaboration. You will work with industry-standard tools such as PSS/E, PSLF, and PSCAD to develop and validate sophisticated generation models. There are also opportunities to contribute to specialized studies, innovative engineering methodologies, and the organization’s technical knowledge base. This is an opportunity to help shape a more sustainable, secure, and resilient power grid while working with experienced energy professionals. Perform and lead generation integration and load interconnection studies within the WECC footprint. Evaluate grid capacity and system impacts to identify optimal interconnection strategies for new generation and load projects. Support interconnection projects through power system modeling, due diligence, technical analysis, and engineering assessments. Create, develop, and validate PSS/E, PSLF, and PSCAD models for renewable energy resources, including solar PV, battery energy storage systems, and wind generation. Conduct and contribute to specialized power system studies such as sub-synchronous resonance, protection coordination, arc flash, and transient overvoltage analyses when required. Analyze complex technical issues and communicate findings and recommendations clearly to internal and external stakeholders. Contribute to the development of innovative study approaches, engineering techniques, and organizational knowledge resources. Participate in engineering meetings, conferences, and technical discussions, and communicate relevant findings and industry developments. Manage multiple projects, tasks, and resources while maintaining quality, accuracy, and delivery expectations. Build and maintain strong relationships with clients, colleagues, and other technical stakeholders. Contribute to continuous improvement initiatives supporting advanced energy analysis and grid modernization. Requirements 3+ years of professional experience as a Power Systems Engineer or in a closely related power engineering role. Experience with generation integration, load interconnection, or power system studies is strongly preferred. Practical experience developing or validating power system models using tools such as PSS/E, PSLF, and PSCAD. Knowledge of renewable generation technologies, particularly solar PV, battery energy storage systems, and wind generation. Understanding of grid capacity, system impacts, interconnection processes, and power system modeling principles. Experience with specialized studies such as sub-synchronous resonance, protection coordination, arc flash, or transient overvoltage is a plus. Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities, with the capacity to evaluate complex power system challenges and develop practical recommendations. Excellent written and verbal communication skills, particularly the ability to explain technical concepts clearly to diverse audiences. Strong organizational skills and the ability to manage multiple projects, priorities, and resources simultaneously. Demonstrated ability to work collaboratively and build effective internal and external relationships. Strong customer-service orientation and commitment to delivering high-quality technical work. Ability to work independently while contributing effectively within a multidisciplinary tea

jobgether-jobgether:lever:eab55ddd-21f3-.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. You will lead the client success function, shaping strategies that strengthen adoption, retention, expansion, and long-term customer value. Develop and implement strategies to reduce churn, increase retention, and maximize customer lifetime value. Capture customer feedback, testimonials, success stories, and case studies that demonstrate measurable value. Collaborate with marketing and sales to incorporate customer advocacy and success stories into business development and promotional initiatives. Deep understanding of customer success principles, strategies, lifecycle management, retention, adoption, and expansion best practices. Demonstrated success developing and executing customer success strategies that improve satisfaction, retention, and commercial outcomes. Proven ability to build, lead, and develop high-performing customer-facing teams. Strong experience managing relationships with senior stakeholders and decision-make

jobgether-jobgether:lever:f8d7c146-7891-.title: Data Analyst
jobgether-jobgether:lever:f8d7c146-7891-.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Data Analyst based in United Kingdom. As a Data Analyst, you’ll transform complex market data into actionable insights that support important commercial and product decisions. You’ll focus on pricing trends and market movements across materials used in semiconductor device manufacturing. The role combines hands-on analysis with data quality management, documentation, and continuous improvement of analytical processes. You’ll work with data from multiple sources, applying rigorous standards to extract, validate, clean, and synthesize information. Your findings will contribute to a high-value market intelligence product and help ensure the reliability of data used by customers and internal teams. You’ll join a fast-paced, cross-functional environment where curiosity, resourcefulness, and the ability to learn new tools are highly valued. The position is fully remote and offers an opportunity to develop your analytical expertise within a specialized technology and market intelligence environment. Analyze data to identify evolving prices and emerging trends across materials used in semiconductor device production, from raw feedstock through finished products. Apply data standards and use a range of analytical tools and techniques to extract, synthesize, clean, and validate information from multiple sources. Monitor data quality and integrity, troubleshoot issues, and ensure consistency across datasets, reports, and analytical outputs. Identify data discrepancies, investigate root causes, and implement appropriate remediation and prevention measures. Identify inconsistencies within data sources and models and contribute to improved data hygiene, quality, and documentation. Create clear documentation for datasets, analytical processes, and findings to support knowledge sharing and continuity. Assist with the design, maintenance, and optimization of data pipelines and ETL processes. Identify opportunities to improve analytical workflows, tools, methodologies, and team best practices. Share analytical findings, insights, and effective practices with colleagues and relevant stakeholders. Contribute to continuous improvement initiatives that strengthen the reliability, efficiency, and scalability of data operations. Requirements Strong experience in data analysis, data cleaning, preparation, validation, or a closely related analytical discipline. Expert-level proficiency in Microsoft Excel , including advanced data manipulation, analysis, and extrapolation techniques. Highly analytical and detail-oriented, with the ability to identify patterns, inconsistencies, and potential data-quality issues. Familiarity with data modeling and data warehouse concepts . Strong critical-thinking and problem-solving skills, with the ability to approach complex issues logically and develop practical solutions. Ability to communicate analytical findings and technical solutions clearly to colleagues and managers. Resourceful, curious, and comfortable learning new tools, techniques, and subject matter quickly. Self-motivated and capable of taking ownership in a fast-paced, cross-functional remote environment. Experience working with multiple data sources and analytical tools, with a strong focus on accuracy and consistency. Experience designing unbiased surveys is an advantage. Knowledge of semiconductor materials or semiconductor manufacturing is a strong plus. Willingness and ability to provide current citizenship and/or permanent residency information as required for compliance with applicable U.S. export control regulations. Legal authorization to work in Germany or the candidate’s primary country of residence without sponsorship. Benefits Fully remote working arrangement across the EU region. Expected salary range of approximately €49,000–€52,000 per year . Company-sponsored training and professional development opportunities

southparkcommons-material-security:ashby.title: Senior Software Engineer, Cloud Office Security
southparkcommons-material-security:ashby.description: As a Senior Software Engineer on our Cloud Office Security team at Material Security, you'll join an early, remote-first team of experienced engineers building the next generation of protection for customers' Google Workspace environments. You'll work end-to-end — frontend and backend — on the Google Drive and OAuth surfaces of our product, and you'll play a leading role in integrating agentic workflows that help security teams investigate and remediate risk faster than ever before. This is a high-ownership role for someone who loves shipping polished product experiences, enjoys the messy realities of integrating with third-party APIs at scale, and is excited about putting LLM-based agents into real production workflows where correctness and trust matter. RESPONSIBILITIES - Build full-stack features across the Google Drive and OAuth areas of our Cloud Office Security product, owning them from design through production. - Design and ship agentic workflows that automate detection, investigation, and remediation of security risks in customer environments. - Integrate deeply with Google Workspace APIs, building reliable pipelines that handle real-world data at scale. - Partner closely with product and design to ship the highest-impact features for our customers. - Collaborate with adjacent product and platform teams to expose Cloud Office Security capabilities throughout the product. - Contribute to a great engineering culture through active participation, code review, and mentorship. WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR - Strong Backend & Systems Skills: Strong software engineering fundamentals and the ability to ship high-quality backend code. You're comfortable designing and operating systems that integrate with third-party APIs at scale — rate limits, retries, idempotency, and messy data are familiar territory. - Full-Stack Comfort: You can work across the stack and are comfortable contributing to the frontend (TypeScript/React) when features require it. Deep frontend specialization isn't required, but you should be effective shipping end-to-end. - Product Sense: You care about the user experience and can make reasonable UX trade-offs with design partners. - Curiosity About Agentic Systems: Experience or strong interest in building LLM-powered agents in production, including prompt design, tool use, and evaluation. - Technical Maturity & Ownership: You write high-quality code without much oversight, understand which risks to take and which to avoid, and stay engaged through production rollout and beyond. - Attitude & Ambition: Smart, hard-working, humble, and not afraid to fail. Team-first but willing to take the lead with minimal guidance. -- Material Security is a remote-first workplace with an office in San Francisco, California. By clicking "Apply for this Job", you acknowledge that you have read the California Candidate Privacy Notice Regarding Use of Personal Information https://material.security/ccpa and hereby agree to its terms. Compensation at Material Security is determined by a range of factors, including but not limited to the individual’s particular combination of knowledge, skills, competencies, and experience. The projected compensation range for this position is $190,000 - $235,000. -- Equal Opportunity Employer Statement Material Security is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, creed, national origin, ancestry, sex, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, disability, genetic information, or any other legally protected status. All employment decisions are based on qualifications, merit, and business needs.

southparkcommons-meesho:lever:7d9af9b5-c.description: About the Team Would you like to be part of creating a unicorn within a unicorn? Solve some of the biggest challenges facing financial inclusion of Bharat? Well, then here’s your chance! Financial Services (FS) is one of the biggest new bets we are taking at Meesho on the next 10x horizon opportunity for us. Just as Ant Financial did for Alibaba, and Mercado Pago did for Mercado Libre, our vision is to build financial services for Meesho, becoming our key growth and revenue driver. We have found our Product-Market Fit and built and proved 0-1 and 1-10 journeys, Now looking for someone who can be the founding member of 10-100-1000 journey and this is possibly one of the most exciting and enriching experiences one could consider in their career. Herein also lies potentially our biggest challenge for Meesho users: How do we assess risk of borrowers without any credit history? How can we leverage alternative information to better profile borrowers? How can we leverage our platform uniquely to create a sustained competitive advantage? The Person will be responsible for driving the Policy, DS and analytics behind all these questions, from creating analytical frameworks, developing high quality analysis, driving insights and actions, and owning policy decisions. In the early phases, your role will focus on refining initially implemented policy by Analyzing and Designing credit policies using Meesho platform data, bureau data, alternate data. Creating Scorecards and models for approval. Designing experiments to test cohort behavior and experimental policies. Automate reporting and tracking of the portfolio on multiple levels , Ops performance measures, key performance indicators and associated drivers.

thegialliancemanagementllccompany-thegia.description: Phoenix Cyberknife & Arizona Radiation Therapy Specialist is seeking for a Certified Medical Dosimetrist The Certified Medical Dosimetrist is responsible for designing, calculating, and optimizing individualized radiation treatment plans in collaboration with Radiation Oncologists and Medical Physicists. This position plays a critical role in delivering safe, accurate, and high-quality radiation therapy using advanced treatment technologies, including Varian Ethos, TrueBeam, Cyberknife and TomoTherapy. The ideal candidate will have strong clinical expertise in treatment planning, image-guided and adaptive radiation therapy, and complex treatment techniques. The Dosimetrist must be able to work independently while collaborating effectively with physicians, physicists, radiation therapists, and the broader multidisciplinary oncology team. Essential Duties and Responsibilities Treatment Planning Design and generate individualized radiation therapy treatment plans based on physician prescriptions, target volumes, normal tissue constraints, and established clinical protocols. Perform treatment planning for a wide range of disease sites using 3D conformal radiation therapy, IMRT, VMAT, SBRT, SRS, and adaptive radiation therapy techniques. Utilize advanced planning systems and technology to create safe, efficient, and clinically optimal treatment plans. Review and evaluate treatment plans to ensure appropriate target coverage, dose conformity, homogeneity, and adherence to normal tissue constraints. Perform dose calculations and plan optimization in accordance with physician directives and departmental standards. Participate in physician plan review and make appropriate modifications based on clinical feedback. Prepare treatment documentation and communicate plan requirements clearly to the treatment delivery team. Ethos Adaptive Radiation Therapy Develop and optimize treatment plans for patients treated on the Varian Ethos platform. Participate in adaptive radiation therapy workflows, including plan preparation, contour review support, plan evaluation, and adaptive treatment planning. Collaborate with Radiation Oncologists, Medical Physicists, and Radiation Therapists to support daily adaptive treatment workflows. Evaluate adapted treatment plans to ensure clinical objectives, target coverage, and organ-at-risk constraints are met. Assist with the development and implementation of standardized workflows, templates, and planning protocols for Ethos adaptive treatments. Maintain knowledge of emerging adaptive radiation therapy technologies and best practices. TrueBeam Treatment Planning Create and optimize treatment plans for delivery on Varian TrueBeam linear accelerators. Develop plans utilizing advanced treatment techniques, including IMRT, 3D, SBRT, and SRS, as applicable. Support planning for image-guided radiation therapy and motion management techniques. Collaborate with physicians and physicists to develop treatment approaches for complex and high-dose treatments. Ensure plans are optimized for efficient and safe delivery while meeting established clinical objectives. Quality and Safety Perform thorough plan checks and participate in quality assurance processes before treatment delivery. Verify treatment plans are complete, accurate, and consistent with physician prescriptions and departmental policies. Work closely with Medical Physics to support patient-specific quality assurance and resolve treatment planning concerns. Identify potential safety concerns and participate in corrective action and process improvement initiatives. Maintain compliance with all applicable regulatory, accreditation, and departmental requirements. Participate in chart rounds, peer review, quality improvement projects, and multidisciplinary conferences as appropriate. weloglobal-weloglobal:lever:090b47c7-256.description: About the Role We are looking for detail-oriented Quality Control (QC) Specialist to support an AI data annotation project. In this role, you will review the work submitted by Trainers — pre-seeded questions paired with images and their corresponding "golden" answers — to confirm accuracy, consistency, and adherence to project guidelines. This is a task-based, remote-friendly opportunity ideal for individuals who are highly meticulous, observant, and skilled at spotting errors or inconsistencies that others may miss. What You'll Do What We're Looking For Work Format & Compensation Review completed tasks submitted by Trainers, including the original question, the image, and the golden answer provided Independently verify whether the golden answer is correct based on the image Identify and flag incorrect, incomplete, ambiguous, or inconsistent answers Provide clear, constructive feedback or corrections to help maintain overall data quality Track recurring error patterns and report them to the project team Ensure Trainer output meets the project's quality bar before final sign-off Escalate unclear cases (e.g., illegible images, ambiguous questions) to the project team for resolution Native/Strong proficiency at Italian Bachelor's degree required Excellent attention to detail and a strong quality mindset Good visual observation and reading comprehension skills Ability to apply guidelines/rubrics consistently and objectively Strong written English communication skills, especially for giving feedback Prior experience in quality assurance, quality control, editing, proofreading, data review, data annotation or data labeling is a plus Reliable access to a computer and internet connection Work Type: freelance, remote Hours/Schedule: 20 hours per week Compensation: $43.2 /hr Duration: Long-term
